preconditions.description: The number of queries q is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 50 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: For each query, n is an integer between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, int) and 0 <= s <= 200 for s in ss)
preconditions.description: For each query, s is an integer between 0 and 200 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(k, int) and 0 <= k <= 2000 for k in ks)
preconditions.description: For each query, k is an integer between 0 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(ns) == q and len(ss) == q and len(ks) == q
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly q triplets of (n, s, k).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1') or (len(line.split()) == n and all(x.isdigit() for x in line.split())) for line, n in zip(output_lines, ns))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either '-1' or a sequence of n non-negative integers.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1') or (sum(int(x) for x in line.split()) == s and sum(abs(int(line.split()[i]) - int(line.split()[j])) for i in range(len(line.split())) for j in range(i, len(line.split()))) == k) for line, n, s, k in zip(output_lines, ns, ss, ks))
postconditions.description: For each query, if a solution exists, the output array sums to s and the sum of absolute differences between all pairs equals k.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1') or (all(int(line.split()[i]) <= int(line.split()[i+1]) for i in range(len(line.split())-1))) for line, n in zip(output_lines, ns))
postconditions.description: For each valid solution, the array is sorted in non-decreasing order to ensure lexicographical minimality.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1') or (all(int(line.split()[i]) == 0 for i in range(len(line.split())) if i < len(line.split()) and int(line.split()[i]) == 0)) for line, n in zip(output_lines, ns))
postconditions.description: The output array is the lexicographically smallest among all valid arrays satisfying the sum and difference constraints.
